current.reasoning: The individual reports engaging in binge eating at least once a week and compensatory behaviors (self-induced vomiting) more than once a week, which meets the criteria for bulimia nervosa. The feelings of loss of control during binges and the influence of body weight on self-esteem further support this diagnosis.

recurrent.reasoning: The individual has described a pattern of binge eating and compensatory behaviors occurring regularly over the past three months, indicating a recurrent nature of the disorder.
